bio: Enjoy a slice of indulgence with an afternoon tea in London. Novotel London Bridge is a 4-star hotel, which is just a short stroll from some of the city's most popular attractions, including The Shard, Tate Modern and St. Paul's Cathedral.  This utterly indulgent treat is the perfect stop for those who plan to make the most of a day out in the Capital. Tuck into a traditional afternoon tea for two.  Savour a mouth-watering selection of delicious sandwiches, various tempting sweet treats and scones smothered in clotted cream and jam all washed down with a classic British cup of tea! Indulge your sweet tooth with this delightful experience.
